problems.source_says: The paper identifies two independent markers who received criteria and model proposals, but does not identify their qualifications or establish that they were domain experts, instructors, or professionals. Human scoring is confirmed; the expert_raters subtype is unsupported under codebook section 6. A lay-rater subtype is also unconfirmed, so the subtype should remain null pending clarification.
problems.quote: Two independent markers evaluated each research proposal independently. Marking criteria and model research proposals were provided to the independent markers prior to evaluation.
problems.locator: PDF p. 12, Measures of students’ practical competencies in CPS; creativity-codebook.md section 6, Measure.

problems.source_says: Dou Bao was explicitly used in five weekly proposal-development dialogues (step 3). A survey followed at the end of the experiment (step 4), and students then submitted a new proposal based on the discussions (step 5, shown as a post-test in Figure 1). The paper does not state whether AI remained available while the final assessed proposal was written. Prior assistance is established, but final-production availability and the resulting with_ai classification are not explicitly established under the codebook rule; they should remain null pending clarification. AI removal is not established either, so after_ai cannot be confirmed.
problems.quote: We asked both groups of students to submit a new research proposal based on the discussions undertaken with either Dou Bao or a peer.
problems.locator: PDF p. 8, Figure 1 and Participants; p. 9, Procedure steps (3)-(4); p. 10, Procedure step (5); creativity-codebook.md sections 1 and 6.

problems.form_value: Practical performance in CPS: research-proposal total score (0-100)
problems.source_says: The paper explicitly states a highest possible total of 100, but does not give zero as the minimum. Every dimension has scores 20, 15, 10, or 5; Table 10 awards 5 even when a proposal component is absent. Thus the 0-100 label asserts an unsupported lower endpoint. The paper also ambiguously describes the total as an average of criterion scores, as the form acknowledges; retain the confirmed 100-point maximum and leave the total minimum null rather than asserting zero.
problems.quote: The scores for level 1, level 2, level 3, and level 4 were 20, 15, 10, and 5, respectively.
problems.locator: PDF p. 12, Measures of students’ practical competencies in CPS; p. 26, Appendix, Table 10, all four score columns.

confirmed.statement: S1-O1 is scored on participants’ submitted research proposals, not self-reported: two independent markers evaluated anonymised proposals with a rubric that includes originality; reported Kappa is 0.83. Criterion 3 holds.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 10, Procedure step (5); p. 12, Measures of students’ practical competencies in CPS; p. 26, Table 10.

confirmed.statement: The other construct code fits the reported composite of research objectives, questions/hypotheses, literature review, design/methods, and originality. Originality also appears in the questions/hypotheses descriptors; separate dimension results are not reported.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 12, proposal-scoring method; p. 20, Table 7; p. 26, Table 10.

confirmed.statement: The participant unit is supported: each student supplied a final proposal, and ANCOVA compared 40 students per arm using the prior proposal score as covariate. Individual rater scores were not treated as separate observations.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 9, Procedure step (1); p. 10, step (5); p. 12, overall grade; p. 13, Data analysis, RQ3; p. 20, Table 7.

confirmed.statement: Every Table 7 value in reported matches the PDF: experimental N 40, mean 57.77, SD 11.79; control N 40, mean 46.38, SD 12.85; df 1, F 15.058***, partial eta squared 0.179; ***p < 0.001. The treatment_higher direction is correct. The table does not label means as raw or adjusted.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 20, Table 7 and its footnote.

confirmed.statement: The additional reported text values also match: F 15.058, p < 0.001, partial eta squared 0.17; Levene F 0.337, p 0.568; regression-slopes F 1.734, p 0.192. The form correctly preserves the text/table difference of 0.17 versus 0.179.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 20, RQ3 results paragraph and Table 7.

confirmed.statement: The experimental group used Dou Bao to develop research-proposal ideas; the control group used a peer and lacked access to similar AI tools. The other_aid control and ai_vs_active comparison are supported.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 8, Participants; p. 9, Procedure step (3).

confirmed.statement: RQ2 usefulness, ease-of-use and intention scores are self-reported perceptions, and interviews concern perceptions. Their exclusion from scored creative-output outcomes is supported.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 12, Measures of students’ perceptions; pp. 19-20, RQ2 and Table 6; p. 25, Tables 8-9.

confirmed.statement: RQ1 speculation/elaboration percentages classify dialogue moves, and lag-sequential results describe transitions between move categories. These are not ratings of proposal creativity or comparisons of different people’s output similarity; the narrative about more diverse dialogue does not establish an across_people outcome.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 10-13, dialogue coding and analysis; p. 14, Tables 2-3; pp. 15-18, Tables 4-5 and Figures 2-3.

confirmed.statement: After reading the entire conversion, including appendices and references, no additional separately reported qualifying outcome was found. The originality rubric dimension has no separate results, and no explicitly AI-removed follow-up or across-person output-diversity measure is reported.
confirmed.locator: Full document, PDF pp. 1-30; particularly pp. 8-13, methods; pp. 14-20, results; pp. 25-26, appendix Tables 8-10.

summary: The proposals were independently scored with a rubric that includes originality, so criterion 3 holds, and the reported statistics match the PDF. Expert-rater status, AI availability during final proposal production and its with_ai classification, and the asserted zero score minimum are unsupported.
